findings.verifierReasoning: The operative source text is only a bare subpart beginning with "(a)"; it does not itself identify who is bound. The actual actor and entity scope would be supplied by the unretrieved preamble of Section 7.17 (the supplied parent-scope item is only the section heading). The proposed IR nevertheless introduces "the obligor" as the actor and leaves entityScope empty. If the real preamble binds e.g. the Company and its Restricted Subsidiaries, the IR under-specifies who is prohibited from being or becoming a covered foreign person; if the preamble binds only the Company, the singular/generic "obligor" may overstate or misstate the scope. Because entity scope is a core element of any covenant, a reviewer relying on this IR could reach a different compliance conclusion depending on which subject the unretrieved preamble actually imposes. This is an unresolved representation gap rather than a confirmed wrong scoping, hence UNCERTAIN.
